title: Top K Frequent Elements: A Record Shop's Two-Slot Display
summary: Count each value, then keep the k highest counts in a min-heap capped at k.

analogy.scenario: A record shop logs which album each customer asks for and has a display window with room for 2 albums. It should show the two most requested.

mapping.real: An album number in the request log

mapping.abstract: A min-heap of counts capped at k = 2

mapping.real: The least requested album on display

takeaway.summary: Count with a hash map, then push (value, count) pairs into a min-heap by count; pop the root whenever it holds k + 1. What's left is the top k.
takeaway.timeComplexity: O(n + m log k) for m distinct values
whenToUse: Ranking by a score you compute first

scenes.narration: A record shop logged seven requests for albums 4, 1, 4, 2, 1, 4, and 3. Its display has room for two. Which two albums were requested most?
scenes.caption: Seven requests, a display with room for two albums

scenes.narration: You could rank every album by its requests, but only the top two matter, and a big shop has thousands of albums.
scenes.caption: Sorting every album by requests ranks more than needed

scenes.narration: First, tally the requests: album 4 three times, album 1 twice, albums 2 and 3 once each.
scenes.caption: First count the requests for each album

scenes.narration: Fill the display with a min-heap by request count. Album 4 goes in, then album 1 sifts up to the root: it's the less requested of the two.
scenes.caption: The least requested album on display sits on top

scenes.narration: Album 2, with one request, sifts to the root, and three albums are one too many. The root leaves: album 2 can't make the display.
scenes.caption: Album 2 has one request: popped right back out

scenes.narration: Album 3 bounces out the same way. The display holds the two most requested albums, 1 and 4.
scenes.caption: Albums 1 and 4 stay on display

scenes.narration: Albums are values, requests are counts, and the display is a min-heap capped at k. Counting is O(n), and each push costs O(log k).
scenes.caption: Albums are values; the display is a size-k min-heap
